definitions.explanation: A measure or principle used as a basis for judgment or comparison.

examples.japanese: ⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{規準|きじゅん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What are the criteria for passing?

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{規準|きじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づいて→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧。
examples.english: I will judge based on this standard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{規準|きじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たす→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: It needs to meet international standards.

notes:
{規準|きじゅん} means a standard, criterion, or norm used as a basis for judgment or comparison.

WRITING:
Also very commonly written as ⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧. Both spellings are read きじゅん and are largely interchangeable. ⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧ (with {基|き} = foundation) is more common in everyday use; {規準|きじゅん} (with {規|き} = rule) emphasizes an established rule or regulation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {規準|きじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧: to establish a standard
- {規準|きじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たす→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧: to meet a standard
- {規準|きじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づく→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧: to be based on a standard
- ⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{規準|きじゅん}: criterion for judgment
- ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{規準|きじゅん}: international standard

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{標準|ひょうじゅん}→標準：04832_hyoujun⟧: standard (more general, as in "standard level")
- ⟦{水準|すいじゅん}→水準：03357_suijun⟧: level, standard (often for quality or economic level)
